item.title: Yeehaw (again)
item.content:encoded:
After finishing up my last tale, I realized I left a loose end in my previous story and that it could be a fun story on its own.

Thanks to Dr. Moned for the crit, as well as all my teammates in the Team With No Name for looking this over as well and for their inspiration for a couple of the ideas that are a little more prominent in this story.

The title is from the song "Roll the Bones" by Rush.

Aces and Eights is an awesome canon. Had a blast with this contest!
